# The Vat That Changed

*One of Hawise's vats turned overnight to a colour she did not put in it and nobody on the bank can name. She wants the crocos that came up the bank that night driven back, and Hereward told before he hears it from someone else.*

|  |  |
|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Bring 10 [Undercut Croco Hide](../items/undercut_croco_hide.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Hereward](../npcs/hereward.md)
